item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera's teacher asks the class why Earth is able to support living things, while the Moon cannot.

Which statement gives the correct reason?

options.A: Earth supports life only because it has water, so no other conditions matter
options.B: Earth supports life because air, water, soil, food and shelter are linked together in a thin surface layer where living things exist
options.C: Earth supports life only because it is the largest rocky planet
options.D: Earth supports life only because it shines brightly in the night sky
